observations.note: Item set plus footer component and two composed FRAME recipes. The component-set canvas is not the item surface. No complete Picker component set or root API properties are supplied.

Four agent/chat x enabled/hovered variants. Sample758x36, radius6, px8/py6, leading gap8, space-between. Enabled transparent, hovered#F8F8F8. Title14/20/600, hidden description12/16/400, agent meta12/16/400. Model slot20 logo+14/20/400 label+16 chevron with gap4. show-description defaultfalse; true has no separate render.

Agent recipe has six actual PickerItem instances (one chat and five assistants), four AgentTypeChip-backed workflow/runtime FRAME rows with radius8 rather than item radius6, section-header source2627:6199, Scroll bar2019:3708, footer2627:62004 and vertical Divider2019:118. This is not automatic replacement by a common Select/Menu.

Search is exact source3142:116457 size32/focused/filtered=false with actual filter Boolean overridden to true (visible filter action). Fourteen32px menu rows use navigation-item sources2611:62440/64577 and direct FRAMEs, not PickerItem36. IconButton source2909:49139 ghost/default20 appears inside menu rows. Source hovered row instances override fills to empty; a source state name alone does not establish visible hover paint.

Both shells white/#DDD1 INSIDE/radius24/Mid/clip=true. Agent recipe776x455 uses semantic8px divider#F4F4F4/top#EEE. Search recipe532x536 uses raw8px divider#F2F2F2/top#E3E3E3, two repeated pinned sections and two below-viewport terminal rows. Do not normalize raw divider values or infer sections from duplicate names.

Standalone768x39 and both bottom absolute instances reuse same source. Top border1 only, #F8F8F8, px12/py10 plus contentpx4, keycaps18 and Divider17x14. Agent footer includes discovery link; search recipe footer-content contains only key-hints, not a visible=false discovery subtree or Boolean API.

Agent footer y416 covers last row area; search footer y497 and root536 clip lower rows. overflowDirection is NONE in both. Scrollbar drawing is not evidence of working scrolling. A consuming viewport must reserve39px footer and expose all keyboard targets without copied clipping/overlay loss.

Keyboard hints imply movement/selection but do not define search/open/close/selection/send behavior. Model/filter/more controls cannot be nested in a button or listbox option. Use a labelled composite panel with sibling native controls; modal/nonmodal dialog or simplified listbox requires an explicit product adoption decision.

Existing exact-source16px icons are reused. Frame-only model/footer chevrons and off-viewport folder glyph plus hidden alternative more glyph have dedicated supplied SVGs. Model logo is a dynamic data slot with a local Qwen sample fixture, not an Agent Hub brand mark.

No dark/mobile/disabled/loading/error/empty/multiple selection/confirmation/closed trigger or runtime focus/search/API behavior has been supplied. Recipes are static Light snapshots, not consuming source/export or runtime verification.
